sloka: को ऽर्थो मनीषितस्तुभ्यं स्वर्गलाभः परो ऽथवा ।वराश्रयो यदर्थं त्वं तपस्यसि सुदुष्करम् ।यमाश्रित्य तपस्तप्तं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तापस ।। ७.७५.१७ ॥
transliteration: ko 'rtho manīṣitastubhyaṁ svargalābhaḥ paro 'thavā ।varāśrayo yadarthaṁ tvaṁ tapasyasi suduṣkaram ।yamāśritya tapastaptaṁ śrotumicchāmi tāpasa ।। 7.75.17 ॥

translations.english: "What is the purpose desired by you, is it the attainment of heaven or some other supreme boon, for which you are performing this very difficult penance, O ascetic? I wish to hear what you have resorted to for performing this penance."
